agentGuide: Who am I: GET /ocs/v2.php/cloud/user?format=json. Files live under WebDAV: PROPFIND /remote.php/dav/files/<user>/<folder> lists a folder (XML; add header Depth: 1), GET /remote.php/dav/files/<user>/<path> downloads (use save_as), PUT /remote.php/dav/files/<user>/<path> with the raw body uploads, DELETE removes. Search: POST /remote.php/dav/ with a SEARCH body is not available; use GET /ocs/v2.php/search/providers/files/search?term=<words>&format=json. Shares: GET /ocs/v2.php/apps/files_sharing/api/v1/shares?format=json, create: POST ... {"path": "/doc.pdf", "shareType": 3} (3 = public link). Calendar and contacts are CalDAV/CardDAV under /remote.php/dav/calendars/<user>/ and /addressbooks/users/<user>/. Always add format=json on OCS calls.
